Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: 🛠️ Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "src/data.yaml"
      - "src/data.schema.json"
      - "dist/data.json"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: projectdiscovery/actions/setup/ajv@v1
      - run: make compile
      - run: make test

  duplicate-domains:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run duplicate domains check
        id: duplicate_check
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          make duplicate-domains | tee duplicate-domains.log
          echo "exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ -s duplicate-domains.log ]; then
            echo "has_output=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            {
              echo "body<<EOF"
              echo "## Duplicate Domain Check"
              echo
              echo "Duplicate domains were found during the check:"
              echo
              echo '```text'
              head -c 60000 duplicate-domains.log
              echo
              echo '```'
              echo "EOF"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_output=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Comment on PR for duplicate domains
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.duplicate_check.outputs.has_output == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          COMMENT_BODY: ${{ steps.duplicate_check.outputs.body }}
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: process.env.COMMENT_BODY
            })
      - name: Fail when duplicate check fails
        if: steps.duplicate_check.outputs.exit_code != '0'
        run: exit 1

  validate-domains:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: projectdiscovery/actions/setup/go@v1
      - name: Run validate domains check
        id: validate_check
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          make validate-domains | tee validate-domains.log
          echo "exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ -s validate-domains.log ]; then
            echo "has_output=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            {
              echo "body<<EOF"
              echo "## Validate Domains Check"
              echo
              echo "Invalid domains were found during the check:"
              echo
              echo '```text'
              head -c 60000 validate-domains.log
              echo
              echo '```'
              echo "EOF"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

            echo "has_output=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install '.[dev]'
      - name: Run tests
        env:
          SPEAKEASY_ENABLE_GDB_TESTS: "1"
        run: pytest tests/

Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf
